subject: GreenMed vendor intake: procurement path & PO timing
messages:
From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anjali Rao <anjali@greenmed.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: GreenMed vendor intake: procurement path & PO timing

Hi Anjali — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and the asks we agreed to pick up: 

- Stakeholder roster: economic buyer is Sarah Liu (CFO), procurement owner is you (Anjali), security/compliance contact is Mark Chen (mchen@greenmed.com).
- Procurement asks we heard: vendor intake form, SOC 2 Type II report, standard security questionnaire answers, SSO/SAML capability, and a signed SOW for the pilot.
- Invoicing / payment terms: you mentioned GreenMed requires a PO before the first invoice; current preference was Net 45 after receipt of invoice. Please confirm invoicing entity and whether remittance address needs to be the legal entity listed on our W-9.
- Timeline: GreenMed is targeting a Q3 pilot kickoff. For planning, can we target a pilot start week of July 18 with a PO/PO number provided at least one week prior (deadline July 11)?

Next steps (owner / by when):
- Kimberly: share mutual action plan (attached) and draft SOW for pilot by EOD tomorrow.
- Anjali: confirm billing entity name and if procurement needs a completed vendor packet / custom PO template.
- Mark: we will send the brief security artifact package; please flag any additional evidence required.

Attachments: GreenMed_Mutual_Action_Plan_20270607.pdf (MAM), SOW_RedwoodPilot_v1.docx (draft)

If you'd prefer a short follow-up call to walk procurement through the MAM, happy to set 20 minutes.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

---
Note: I flagged Jordan & Aditya to help with billing/legal questions and to prep the finance handoff if GreenMed requires nonstandard terms.

From: Anjali Rao <anjali@greenmed.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mark Chen <mchen@greenmed.com>, procurement_ops <procurement@greenmed.com>
Date: 2027-06-08T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GreenMed vendor intake: procurement path & PO timing

Kimberly — thanks for the summary and the MAM. Quick clarifications from procurement: 

- Invoicing entity: invoices must be addressed to GreenMed Health, Inc. (EIN 12-3456789). Remittance is centralized; please include our PO number on all invoices.
- Vendor packet: our intake team requires a completed vendor questionnaire (we have a form in procurement Ops) plus the W-9. Can you fill and return the vendor packet PDF?
- Payment terms: Net 45 is our standard, but finance can consider Net 30 for pilots with completed credit checks — that'll take ~3 business days.
- PO timing: our deadline to include Redwood in the July pilot batch is July 11; we will issue a PO once the packet, SOW, and W-9 are approved.

Mark — please confirm whether the SOC 2 Type II we receive from Redwood is sufficient or if you need the raw evidence files. If so, we can schedule a short technical review.

I can take a 20-minute walk-through next Wednesday (June 16) 10–11am PT if that works for your team.

Regards,
Anjali Rao
Procurement Program Manager, GreenMed Health
anjali@greenmed.com
+1 (415) 555-9933

From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anjali Rao <anjali@greenmed.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, Mark Chen <mchen@greenmed.com>
Date: 2027-06-08T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GreenMed vendor intake: procurement path & PO timing

Thanks Anjali — appreciated. A few concrete items attached / linked below to speed intake: 

- Attached: SOW_RedwoodPilot_v1.docx (pilot scope, success criteria, deliverables).
- Attached: Redwood_MAM_20270607.pdf (mutual action plan with milestones).
- Security: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and our security summary are in the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAM. If you need raw artifacts, we can provision access under an NDA or provide a secure upload link.
- Vendor packet: we'll complete GreenMed's questionnaire today and return by EOD. W-9 attached in the vendor packet response.

On payment terms — we can accept Net 45 for the pilot as noted. If finance can expedite to Net 30 for the initial month, that helps our cash cadence but is not required to begin the pilot. If GreenMed needs a shorter window, please let us know and we can discuss an approved exception.

Next steps I propose: 
- Kimberly: upload completed vendor packet + W-9 to procurement@greenmed.com by 2027-06-08 EOD.
- Anjali: confirm whether a signed SOW is needed before PO issuance or if you can issue a PO referencing the SOW ID.
- Mark: let us know if SOC 2 redacted report is sufficient or if you want to schedule a 30-minute technical call (I can bring our security engineer).

DocuSign SOW (draft): https://www.docusign.com/12345SOW
HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/GM-2027-0421

Thanks — I'll push the vendor packet now.

Best,
Kimberly
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: jordan_blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-09T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: GreenMed PO / terms strategy

Quick internal note — looping Jordan & Aditya for visibility.

Kimberly, good plan. A couple of asks from revenue ops before you finalize vendor packet: 

- If GreenMed wants Net 30 for the pilot, we should capture that in the initial SOW or attach a one-line payment amendment. Finance will need the PO template and an estimate of expected invoice dates.
- Ask finance for a quick credit check if they push for Net 60 or longer. We shouldn't agree to >Net 60 without approval.
- Prepare a single-sheet handoff for billing (billing contact, remit-to, tax ID, PO reference). I can draft and send for sign-off.

If you want, I can join the June 16 walk-through with procurement.

—Jordan
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
